user.title: Connect to an Auvi NVR recorder
user.description: The recorder's local web UI runs over HTTPS (port 8443 by default) behind the admin login you created on the recorder. The RTSP password is the one set on the recorder's RTSP tab; it turns shared streams into camera entities.

data_description.host: IP address or host name on your LAN, e.g. 10.0.3.2
data_description.username: The recorder has one local account, admin
data_description.rtsp_password: Leave empty to add no camera entities

trust_cert.title: Trust this recorder

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The recorder at {host} refused the stored admin password.

error.cannot_connect: The recorder could not be reached. Check the address, the port and the firewall rule for the HTTPS port.
error.no_password_set: The recorder has no admin password yet. Open its web UI once and create the password, then try again.
error.cert_error: The recorder's certificate could not be used.

abort.already_configured: This recorder is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That address belongs to a different recorder.

data.panel_require_admin: Only administrators may open the sidebar panel
data.events_enabled: Real-time events (the recorder posts every detection to Home Assistant)
data.events_base_url: Home Assistant URL the recorder should post to (optional)
data.events_local_only: Accept event posts from the local network only
data.events_insecure_tls: Let the recorder skip certificate checks when posting over HTTPS

data_description.events_enabled: Installs one rule per camera on the recorder's Rules tab; switching it off removes them again.
data_description.events_base_url: Leave empty to use Home Assistant's internal URL. Set it when the recorder must reach Home Assistant another way, e.g. http://10.0.1.5:8123
data_description.events_insecure_tls: Only for a Home Assistant behind a self-signed certificate
